adminOnly: Only an admin can change the packing setup.

page.errorMessage: Something went wrong while reading your setup. Try again.
page.errorTitle: Could not load the packing setup
page.loadingMessage: Reading your connections, locations and stock.
page.statusDescription: What OpenLinker takes over: packing at the pack bench, then sales documents and automations. You can stop packing at any time.
page.wizardDescription: Pick and pack orders on one screen, with a barcode scanner. Setup takes about 5 minutes. Nothing changes in how your orders are handled until the last step.

salesDocumentsStep.automaticRequiredBody: Choose what a connection issues, mark it Primary, and set its Trigger to an automatic option (for example Auto on order paid). With the Trigger on Manual, nothing is issued unless someone does it by hand.
salesDocumentsStep.noConnectionBody: Connect a provider that issues invoices (for example inFakt or Subiekt) or fiscal receipts first. Then come back here to choose what it issues.
salesDocumentsStep.noConnectionTitle: No invoicing or fiscal receipt connection yet
salesDocumentsStep.perCountry: Rules for a particular country, or a default for orders no rule covers, are set on the document routing page.
salesDocumentsStep.why: Decide which document each order gets: an invoice or a receipt. Connect a provider that issues them, then say what each one issues, which goes first, and whether it issues by itself once an order is paid.

automations.detail: Automations live on their own page. Review them, or add more, whenever you like.
automations.why: Automations let OpenLinker act by itself when something happens, for example tell the buyer when an order is packed. Shipping labels are set in the Shipping step. Nothing is set here: this is a look at what exists.

salesDocuments.detail: Document routing is configured on its own page. You can come back here when you are done.
salesDocuments.why: Packing works. Next, decide which document each order gets: an invoice or a receipt, country by country.

state.unknown: Could not check this right now

whoDecides.detail: This is a review, not a form: nothing here changes until you choose an arrangement.
whoDecides.why: Check which system decides stock, packing and returns. Anything that needs your attention is listed there.

shippingStatus.none: No delivery method goes to a carrier yet. You buy each label yourself.

off.one: {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods go to a carrier. You buy each label yourself.
off.other: {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods go to a carrier. You buy each label yourself.

on.one: Labels are bought when a parcel is accepted, for {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods.
on.other: Labels are bought when a parcel is accepted, for {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods.

shippingStatus.stopBody: Parcels accepted from now on reach the pack bench without a label. Labels already bought stay. Your routing and default parcel are kept.
shippingStatus.title: Shipping
shippingStatus.unknown: Could not check this right now.

autoLead.one: Available for {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods. For the others you buy the label at the pack bench.
autoLead.other: Available for {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods. For the others you buy the label at the pack bench.

shippingStep.autoLocked: Give at least one delivery method a carrier and save it first.
shippingStep.cannotList: This connection does not report its delivery methods, so its orders cannot go to a carrier. You buy their labels at the pack bench.

coverage.one: {withCarrier} of {n} delivery method goes to a carrier
coverage.other: {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods go to a carrier

shippingStep.coverageUnknown: Could not read the routing for this connection right now.
shippingStep.defaultsLead: Used when a delivery method has no default parcel of its own.
shippingStep.defaultsTitle: Default parcel for every delivery method

fromNow.one: From now on a label is bought for each parcel accepted on that delivery method{parcel}. Nothing is bought for an order on hold, unpaid or without an address, and orders already waiting are not changed.
fromNow.other: From now on a label is bought for each parcel accepted on those {n} delivery methods{parcel}. Nothing is bought for an order on hold, unpaid or without an address, and orders already waiting are not changed.

shippingStep.fromNowParcel: , with {parcel} unless the delivery method sets its own
shippingStep.loadFailed: Could not load this connection's delivery methods. Its routing is unchanged.
shippingStep.noBody: At the pack bench or in Orders. Nothing is bought on its own.
shippingStep.noCarrierBody: OpenLinker buys labels on your own carrier account, such as InPost or DPD. When the carrier is connected, you come back to this step.
shippingStep.noSourcesBody: No connection sends orders to OpenLinker yet, so there are no delivery methods to choose a carrier for.
shippingStep.routesLead: The same routing as on each connection's mapping page. A change here is a change there.
shippingStep.saveFailedTitle: Could not save the label settings
shippingStep.unsavedBody: You changed which carrier ships some delivery methods and did not click Save routing. If you go on, those changes are lost.
shippingStep.weightDescription: Per product, used only when a product has no weight. The parcel weight is the sum of its products.
shippingStep.weightRequired: Enter a weight for products that have none.
shippingStep.why: Choose which carrier ships each delivery method. Then OpenLinker can buy the label as soon as a parcel is accepted for packing, so the packer only prints it.
shippingStep.yesBody: One label per parcel, on the carrier account its delivery method goes to.
shippingStep.yesTitle: Yes, buy it when a parcel is accepted

status.addPackerDialogBody: They sign in at the pack bench with this login.

arrivedMeta.one: {n} product · {ago} · any packer can pick it up, or assign it on Fulfilment
arrivedMeta.other: {n} products · {ago} · any packer can pick it up, or assign it on Fulfilment

status.arrivedStock: Stock goes down in {names}. The order itself stays in OpenLinker.
status.offBody: New orders go to {names} and are packed there, as before. Your stock setup is kept.
status.onBodyWaiting: New orders now go to the pack bench.

automations.done: At least one automation is set up.
automations.pending: None yet. Optional: let OpenLinker act when an order is packed, for example tell the buyer.
automations.title: Automations

salesDocuments.pending: Documents are issued by hand, or not at all. Mark a connection Primary and set its Trigger to automatic.
salesDocuments.title: Sales documents

steps.unknown: Could not check this right now.

whoDecides.pending: Something needs your attention in who decides stock, packing and returns.
whoDecides.title: Who decides what

status.waitingBody: It shows up here as soon as OpenLinker downloads it, usually within a few minutes. You can leave this page.

step1.completeBody: OpenLinker can now pack every product.
step1.completeTitle: All stock is up to date
step1.conflictBody: {name} already sends its stock to another place. Packing in OpenLinker uses one warehouse for now, so change that in the connection's settings first.
step1.failedHint: Nothing is lost. Confirm again to continue from where it stopped.

failedStep.connection: Could not create the packing connection.
failedStep.override: Could not point the stock of {name} at the warehouse.

step1.mainInactiveBody: The warehouse OpenLinker packs from is marked inactive. Turn it back on in Inventory › Locations, then confirm again.
step1.noMasterBody: Connect the product master that holds your products and stock, for example PrestaShop, WooCommerce or Subiekt GT. Then come back here.
step1.noMasterWhy: OpenLinker has no products or stock of its own. It reads them from your product master. Connect it first.
step1.noStockYetBody: OpenLinker has not received any stock yet. It arrives with the next stock sync. You don't need to wait here.
step1.partialBody: {name} does not share its {missing} with OpenLinker. Turn it on in the connection's settings.
step1.partialTitle: Not usable as a product master yet
step1.syncingBody: You don't need to wait here. Until it reaches {total}, an order for a product not counted yet is handled the old way.
step1.syncingTitle: Filling in with each stock sync from {names}

tooManyBody.one: You have {n} product master. Packing in OpenLinker works with one or two for now. Turn off the ones you do not need, then come back here.
tooManyBody.other: You have {n} product masters. Packing in OpenLinker works with one or two for now. Turn off the ones you do not need, then come back here.

step1.twoBody: Keep each product in one product master only. If the same product is in both, OpenLinker sees two different products with two separate stock counts. A sale lowers the stock only in the product master it came from, so the other one can still sell the last units.
step1.twoTitle: Both product masters send stock to this one place
step1.why: OpenLinker has no products or stock of its own. It reads them from your product master.

step2.createdBody: Give them the login {login} and the password below. It is shown only once. They are asked to change it at first sign-in.
step2.emailHint: Leave empty if the packer has no work email. The role is always Packer.
step2.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
step2.emailTaken: That email is already used by another account.
step2.existingBody: Change their role to Packer in
step2.loginHint: What they type at the pack bench to sign in.
step2.loginTaken: That login is already taken. Pick another one.
step2.unassignedBody: Any packer can pick up an unassigned order at the pack bench. To give an order to a specific person, assign it on the Fulfilment page.
step2.why: Create a login for each person who packs. They see the pack bench and nothing else. You can skip this and pack yourself: admins and operators can open the pack bench too.

step3.ack: I understand that marketplace orders stay in OpenLinker, and only stock goes down in {names}.
step3.benchBody: Arrives as Unassigned. A packer picks it up, scans and packs it.

benchBoxItems.inStock: When every product is in stock and the order has a delivery address
benchBoxItems.newOrders: New orders from Allegro, Erli and your other marketplaces, placed after you turn it on

step3.benchBoxTwo: An order with products from both shops is packed as one parcel

allMarketplaces.body: You can't turn it on for Allegro only.
allMarketplaces.title: It applies to all your marketplaces at once.

labels.body: At the pack bench or in Orders, or automatically when a parcel is accepted for packing, if you turn that on in the Shipping step. Then Allegro and Erli get the shipped status and the tracking number.
labels.title: You buy labels in OpenLinker.

printing.body: It doesn't create them. Invoices and receipts follow your Sales documents settings, as today.
printing.title: The pack bench prints the label and the invoice.

stayInOpenLinker.body: They no longer appear as orders in {names}, and sales reports there won't include them. Only the stock of the sold products goes down there.
stayInOpenLinker.title: Marketplace orders stay in OpenLinker.

step3.masterAfterOne: Doesn't get the order. Only the stock of the sold products goes down.
step3.masterAfterTwo: Don't get the order. Stock goes down in the shop that sells each product.
step3.masterTodayOne: Gets the order. Stock goes down there. You pack from {name}.
step3.masterTodayTwo: Both get the order. Each shop takes only its own products, so an order with products from both fails in one of them.
step3.olTodayBody: Downloads the order and passes it on

sameBoxItems.alreadyIn: Orders already in {names} before you turn it on
sameBoxItems.marketplaceShips: Orders the marketplace ships itself, for example Allegro One Fulfillment
sameBoxItems.ownStore: Orders from your {names} store. You pack them there.

waitBoxItems.noAddress: An order with no delivery address
waitBoxItems.outOfStock: An order where even one product is out of stock

step3.why: Read this before you turn it on. You can turn it off with one click, but orders already sent to the pack bench stay there.

step4.noLocationBody: Go back to step 1 and confirm your product master again. That creates it.
step4.noLocationTitle: There is no active warehouse to pack from
step4.noPackers: No packers yet, admins and operators can pack
step4.otherSystemBody: Turning this on now would leave two systems deciding the same thing, and OpenLinker would stop deciding at all. Check it on the Who decides what page first.
step4.otherSystemTitle: Another system already decides where orders are packed
step4.why: Everything is ready. From the moment you turn it on, new orders go to the pack bench.

bodyExisting.one: The {n} parcel already at the pack bench stays there. Finish packing it there.
bodyExisting.other: The {n} parcels already at the pack bench stay there. Finish packing them there.

stopDialog.bodyExistingNone: Nothing is on Fulfilment right now.
stopDialog.bodyKept: Invoices and receipts are still issued automatically, for new orders too. Your automations keep running. Your stock setup is kept, so you can turn fulfilment back on with one click.
stopDialog.bodyNewOrders: New orders will go to {names} and be packed there, as before.
stopDialog.title: Turn off fulfilment in OpenLinker?
